tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground for channels and studio. shadcn --background.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text and headlines on background, card, popover and muted (≥14:1 both themes).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, panels, dialogs. Light theme separates cards with border, not shade.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Turf. The platform's one action colour: primary buttons, links, selected nav, focus ring. As text, on background, card and muted (≥7:1).

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill. Dark theme uses dark ink because the lightened turf needs it.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: table header, empty states, transcript panel, skeletons.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Metadata, bylines, captions, helper text. On background, card and muted (≥6:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: shadcn hover and highlighted-row fill (menus, list items). Not a brand colour.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Delete, takedown, failed import, form errors. As text on background and card.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card outlines, dividers. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Form control borders (≥3:1 on background in both themes).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset in background colour.

tokens.name: floodlight
tokens.usage: Brand highlight. Fill only, with floodlight-foreground on it: the Exclusive tag, the mark's dot, marketing highlights. Never text on white (1.8:1).

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: LIVE indicator only. Always paired with the word LIVE. Pages carrying it never show wagering ads (TLK-08).

tokens.name: scheduled
tokens.usage: Scheduled status and info notices. As text on background and card.

tokens.name: ad-frame
tokens.usage: The ground inside every ad frame. Slightly off the page so the unit reads as separate without a shadow.

tokens.name: ad-label
tokens.usage: The Advertisement or Sponsored label inside the frame.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Active sidebar item marker and icon.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Charts series 3 (floodlight, darkened for marks): sign-ups.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Charts series 5 (neutral): comparison or previous period.

tokens.name: channel-turf
tokens.usage: Channel accent option: Default accent. Footy, racing, grass codes. Pre-checked: white text on the light value, dark text on the dark value, both ≥6:1.

tokens.name: channel-harbour
tokens.usage: Channel accent option: Blue clubs, swimming, sailing. Pre-checked: white text on the light value, dark text on the dark value, both ≥6:1.

tokens.name: channel-maroon
tokens.usage: Channel accent option: Deep red clubs. Reads as red without signalling error. Pre-checked: white text on the light value, dark text on the dark value, both ≥6:1.

tokens.name: channel-navy
tokens.usage: Channel accent option: Conservative publishers and racing bodies. Pre-checked: white text on the light value, dark text on the dark value, both ≥6:1.

tokens.name: channel-ochre
tokens.usage: Channel accent option: Gold clubs. The dark ochre is the only gold that holds white text. Pre-checked: white text on the light value, dark text on the dark value, both ≥6:1.

tokens.name: channel-violet
tokens.usage: Channel accent option: Purple clubs, lifestyle channels. Pre-checked: white text on the light value, dark text on the dark value, both ≥6:1.

tokens.name: channel-ember
tokens.usage: Channel accent option: Orange clubs, motorsport. Pre-checked: white text on the light value, dark text on the dark value, both ≥6:1.

tokens.name: channel-slate
tokens.usage: Channel accent option: Neutral channels that want no colour. Pre-checked: white text on the light value, dark text on the dark value, both ≥6:1.

styles.name: display-1

styles.name: display-2

styles.name: headline

styles.name: title

styles.usage: All studio and admin text, forms, tables.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Helper text, metadata, bylines on cards.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase section label above headlines and the Advertisement label.

styles.name: standfirst
styles.sample: The Blues have a midfield problem, and it starts at the centre bounce.
styles.usage: The one-paragraph summary under an article headline.

styles.name: article

styles.usage: Article body. Set at a 68ch measure.

styles.name: pullquote
styles.sample: You can't coach that turn of speed.

styles.name: timecode
styles.usage: Video durations, chapter and transcript timestamps, IDs in admin evidence tables.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, minimum page gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gap, page gutter on tablet.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between related modules, page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs only. Cards and ads take no shadow.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Article body column (65–75 characters a line).

ad-size.note: Reserved slot sizes (ADS-01). Space is held before the ad loads, so CLS stays at 0.
